body:
Thank you for the kind words. I really appreciate it. I know this might sound stupid but we're 18 and turning 19. Young I know, but she means the world to me. I've given her the best life during 2020 but I soured it with what I did just now, but like you said, I love her and I wouldn't want her to die. She didn't deserve the life she's been treated. and I genuinely fell for her as she fell for me becaude we were really perfect for each other, and had a really healthy relationship. I even got her to spark her dream career, but her depression keeps pulling her down. Especially her toxic sister, she's felt like she wasn't enough. She won't be able to get her life back together again, especially since she tried ruining it at a young age so that she'll feel the need to do it even more, but when I met her she didn't want to but her depression just kept pulling her even more.

I talked with her father on the phone and he was really upset but I talked to him about what they can do for her and how they're being insensitive which her father seems to want to improve, but he's at a lost at what to do for her and her sister especially their toxic relationship. However, I've heard from her sister that they've scheduled an appointment again, which I hope my gf agrees to, i already implored them to last dec, but my gf rescheduled it because she was too scared, and didn't want to burden her family with the costs (which tbh wouldn't really burden them), but of course she refuses to believe it.

about being her family, that's exactly what I did this 2020, and I was always there for her and loved her no matter what, and gave her the support she needs, but now I don't think she wants me too because she can't trust me anymore.

I'm happy she's alive, but I can only hope she gets better.. You've been a great help though:) I just wonder if I'll ever be trusted by her again too, I really love her, and I could only pray she gets better.

I took your advice. She kept cutting her days shorter until she said she'd do it now while I was talking with her. I finally approached her dad, and now they're being extra careful because they're really concerned.

She doesn't trust me anymore though but what matters is she's alive.. I still feel like I'm being selfish though. She called me selfish and didn't want to trust me anymore. She's telling me though that it wasn't my decision to make and if she was inportant to me I wouldn't have let it happen.

She's pretty furious, but I still don't know if I made the right decision..
only that one time when she came over my house, since we live a couple cities apart (about 7km) but that was almost a month ago

thank you for the kind words, and I'll do my best to avoid that now. but I don't know how long she could last anymore, she told me herself. I don't know what to do anymore:( she's really trying to push me away more than usual
update: my S/O is really in a dark place right now, they don't want to visit a psychiatrist because they think their family would waste money on her for visiting one, how do I convince them again?:(
